checks.name: page identity
meaningful catalogue and six original synthetic listings
no framework error overlay
desktop no horizontal overflow
keyboard skip link
listing retains seller statement disclaimer and server-owned price
loading disables repeated review submission
repeated click produced one review request
live review receives the current local model response rather than unavailable fallback
requirements remain beside unverified suggested quotes and full saved seller context
explicit acknowledgement required before review confirmation
editing an unconfirmed draft disables an enabled buyer confirmation
confirmation restores keyboard focus to its heading
sandbox checkout is visibly disabled without configuration
review persists after refresh
editing requirements requires a new review before further approval
mobile no horizontal overflow
merchant edit visibly invalidates reviewed version
changed listing requires a fresh unconfirmed review snapshot
buyer explicitly approves the fresh version before disabled checkout
back/navigation returns a working catalogue
browser forward restores the saved review and shop link still works
disabled checkout makes no order creation or provider action request
console health

flow: catalogue -> listing -> up to three requirements -> suggested seller quotes and neutral questions -> saved full seller context -> explicit review -> disabled sandbox checkout -> controlled merchant edit -> stale review -> fresh review and approval
scope: Local synthetic listings only; no payment, account or credential actions
